title: Cautious Claims
text:
Economists rarely speak with absolute certainty. In a recent working paper, the authors argued that remote work may have reduced urban rents, though they acknowledged that the evidence is largely based on a single city. Their cautious phrasing reflects a broader norm in the field, where claims are typically qualified rather than stated outright.

Journalists, by contrast, often compress such findings into confident headlines. The authors themselves noted that further data from other cities would be needed before any policy conclusion could be drawn, and a few critics went further, questioning whether the decline in rents would persist once offices reopened.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, the evidence for the claim about urban rents is based mainly on what?

Why does the writer contrast economists with journalists?
options: To show that journalists are more reliable than economists
To highlight the gap between cautious academic claims and confident public reporting
To suggest that economists rarely publish their work
To argue that headlines should be banned

questions.text: What can be inferred about the critics mentioned in paragraph two?
options: They accept the authors' findings without question
They doubt that the rent decline would last

paragraph_translations: Los economistas rara vez hablan con certeza absoluta. En un documento de trabajo reciente, los autores sostuvieron que el trabajo remoto podría haber reducido los alquileres urbanos, aunque reconocieron que la evidencia se basa en gran medida en una sola ciudad. Su redacción prudente refleja una norma más amplia en el campo, donde las afirmaciones suelen matizarse en lugar de presentarse de forma rotunda.

Los periodistas, en cambio, suelen condensar estos hallazgos en titulares seguros. Los propios autores señalaron que se necesitarían más datos de otras ciudades antes de poder extraer cualquier conclusión política, y algunos críticos fueron más lejos, cuestionando si la caída de los alquileres se mantendría una vez que las oficinas reabrieran.
